description: This file defines the CurrentUserAccessor class which implements ICurrentUserAccessor interface. It provides a method to retrieve the current username based on the claims in the HTTP context, utilizing IHttpContextAccessor for dependency injection.

classes.name: CurrentUserAccessor
classes.description: Implements ICurrentUserAccessor to provide access to the current user's username through HTTP context claims.

methods.name: GetCurrentUsername
methods.description: Retrieves the current user's username from the claims present in the HTTP context, returning null if not available.
